notes.title: Ver1.0.10033 QoL Improvements and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Thank you very much for playing and for your feedback. 
In this update:

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the timing to make it more intuitive when holding the gamepad A button to drag/drop an item in the inventory.
[*] Added instructions on how to equip a weapon. 
[*] Changed the default selection of the dungeon area list to the latest area number when entering a dungeon. 
[*] Sped up the speed at which items move towards the player robot. 
[*] Adjusted the drop rate of medium type items. 
[*] Blocked access to some undeveloped areas in the world. 
[*] Improved some guidance and visual elements.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes: [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a Steam Deck touchscreen-related bug. (Special thanks to our dear player Mifuyne for the bug report and helping with debugging!) 
[*] Fixed some graphics and UI-related bugs.
[/list]

We will continue to improve the game, so if you have any opinions or questions, we would be grateful if you could contact us on the Steam community or Discord. 
Thank you!

Steam Community:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2658960

Discord server:
https://discord.gg/9Yx5tXRtp8

notes.title: Ver1.0.10019 Release Notes
notes.notes:
Thank you very much for playing! 

In this update, we have:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the menu focus and the robot move on their own, even though no button is pressed on some laptops.
[*] Adjusted the game balance to alleviate stress in the early stages.
[*] Removed unnecessary camera behaviors.
[/list]

[b]Special thanks to ちゃとらさん for reporting this bug and providing us with feedback![/b]

We aim to continuously improve the game. If you have any opinions or questions, please feel free to contact us on the Steam community or Discord. Thank you!
